title: Knobby Crispy Dutch Potato Hash
description: A tangy and crispy one-pot Dutch dish made with boiled potatoes and a dairy-free friendly tempering chocolate sauce, served in a molcajete vessel.
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a large molcajete vessel.
Add the diced potatoes to the boiling water and cook for 10 minutes or until tender.
Drain the potatoes and set them aside to cool.
In the same molcajete vessel, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the diced onion to the molcajete vessel and cook until translucent.
Add the cooled potatoes, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder to the molcajete vessel and stir to combine.
Use a spoon to shape the potato mixture into a flat hash shape.
Cook the hash for 5 minutes or until the bottom is crispy and golden brown.
Flip the hash over and cook for an additional 5 minutes or until the other side is also crispy and golden brown.
Melt the tempering chocolate in a double boiler and stir until smooth.
Drizzle the melted chocolate over the crispy potato hash and serve hot.
